The document contains specifications for two butterfly control valves.
Valves TV-1-320-10 and TV-2-320-10 are detailed with design conditions, valve specifications, and pending information.
Both valves have a hazardous area classification of Class1, Division 2.
The valves require calibration certificates and functional testing.
